misconceptions.wrong: Animal cells have a cell wall.
misconceptions.right: Only plant, fungal and bacterial cells have walls.

misconceptions.wrong: All cells are the same size and shape.
misconceptions.right: Cells are specialised for their function.

infoPanels.title: A TYPICAL ANIMAL CELL
infoPanels.secondaryContent: The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell.

questions.text: Use the word bank to name the four labelled parts of the animal cell above. [4 marks]

footer.tip: Remember: mitochondria release energy, ribosomes make proteins.
footer.thinkPrompt: Why do muscle cells contain large numbers of mitochondria?
